descriptions.d16c_cursor_init_80118d04: Initialise the targeting cursor base with its mesh, bitmap and Target/Intro/Loop/Error clips, subscribe to the cursor message (+40), load the Targeting.Cursor.Shadow mesh and retain it as the shadow (+92, releasing the previous one), apply the shadow colour, attach it to the scene (+28) with the Target_Shadow clip, and clear the fields at +96 and +100.
